description: Hero Section block. A headline floating in a field of party photos.
docs:
iPartyLabs Hero — A headline floating in a field of party photos.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep them together in components/blocx/.

Its images are not part of this package. Copy public/blocx/partylabs-hero/ from https://github.com/shadcn-labs/Pin-UI/tree/main/public/blocx/partylabs-hero into your own public/ folder (30 files), or change the paths at the top of the component.
